Building next-generation AgTech
Smart electric tractors and DIY irrigation systems are helping farmers address emerging environmental challenges.
Read more
The Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE) Department at UC Santa Cruz advances technologies that shape how we live, work, and connect. ECE combines curiosity, creativity, and rigorous engineering to solve real-world challenges. Through pioneering research and hands-on learning, faculty and students explore new ideas and build bold solutions across fields.
Meet our faculty and staff in Electrical and Computer Engineering.
FACULTY SPOTLIGHT
Marco Rolandi, professor of electrical and computer engineering, designed a smart device that uses AI and bioelectronics to speed up wound healing.

Why study Electrical and Computer Engineering at Baskin Engineering
The ECE department develops technology for social good. Faculty and students engineer tools to support human health and accessibility, advance sustainable farming, protect autonomous systems, and improve energy efficiency. Through this work, we are creating a healthier, safer, and more sustainable world.
